description: This file defines the 'TodoList' React functional component, which manages and displays a list of to-do items. It handles loading todos from an API, adding new todos, updating existing ones, toggling completion status, and deleting todos. It also manages UI states such as loading and errors.

methods.name: loadTodos
methods.description: Fetches all to-do items from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleAddTodo
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new to-do item, sending data to the API and updating state.

methods.name: handleUpdateTodo
methods.description: Updates an existing to-do item via the API and updates state.

methods.name: handleDeleteTodo
methods.description: Deletes a to-do item via the API and updates state.

methods.name: handleToggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a to-do item via the API and updates state.
